game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Market Square, a bustling cobbled market square: the knight must hold off rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Counter Tower: Increase a counter variable every time grain sacks reach the throne, stacking the tower higher.
theme: The Kingdom – Market Square: a bustling cobbled market square
core_gameplay_loop: In Market Square, repeat each round: Increase a counter variable every time grain sacks reach the throne, stacking the tower higher. Then check delivered and advance.
player_objective: Protect the throne from rogue crows in Market Square: keep delivered above zero until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Counter Tower
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 3, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

tutorial.message: Rogue crows are coming! Watch the delivered meter.
Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Look at the code: delivered = delivered + 1
Survive for 36 seconds to complete the level.
